source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: A maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of 3.5 is a commonly accepted threshold for biopsy of a lesion for MPNST in NF1, based on a review of 12 studies of 353 NF1 patients.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 27 Treglia 2012 PMID 22991664. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.The guideline states this threshold needs validation in large prospective studies with histologic confirmation.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 27
